headline: Open-Source Models Drive Inference Efficiency and Autonomous Agent Advancements
summary: DeepSeek's DeepInfer and NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Super VL are leading a surge in open-source models that significantly boost inference efficiency and enhance autonomous agents' reasoning capabilities, challenging proprietary systems and driving innovation.
whyItMatters: This trend democratizes advanced AI technologies, reducing costs and increasing accessibility for developers and businesses, while also fostering competition and innovation in the AI ecosystem.

primaryArticle.title: DeepSeek DeepInfer: Open Source Model Sets New Standards in Inference Efficiency

supportingStories.title: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL Unveiled: A Multimodal Model for Autonomous Agents
